scope: Scratch evidence audit, collector and read-only lamp handoff; no task source edits or Cargo runs.
corrections: Missing parser counts retain counts_error and remain archivable but unqualified.
Run/build outer_timeout rejects qualification even if process exit is zero.
Task compatibility minute requires running executable hash to equal exact-head native CI artifact.
README distinguishes UTC boundaries from monotonic elapsed durations and allows an active build to finish without claiming a failed build ends after Mac sampling.

synthetic_checks.method: SYNTHETIC evidence-script checks only. Ten rows replay ONE completed Mac run, with deliberate metadata mutations. This is not ten real runs, qualification evidence, a Cargo run, a native run, or lamp evidence.

note: The tested audit and collector included the final README wording. The collector later added only the review/self-check JSON copies and an explicit synthetic-check paragraph; its qualification predicate and failure handling did not change.
